name: Atlassian Rovo MCP Server (remote)
description: Atlassian-hosted remote MCP server for Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Bitbucket, Goals, Projects and Loom; actions respect the user's existing permissions; calls consume Rovo credits.

provenance.notes: Registry entry com.atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server version 2.0.0, status active, published 2026-09-09; two streamable-http remotes https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp and https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2. Supports version, transport. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

Atlassian docs: OAuth 2.1 authorization is primary, API token authentication optional; actions respect existing access controls; MCP calls consume Rovo credits; from March 1, 2027 v1 usage automatically moves to v2 tools. Supports auth_methods; billing_class metered. auth_methods records the credential types the server accepts from the client or its environment: oauth2 = MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1) or an upstream OAuth login; api_key = a static bearer/personal/agent token passed by header or environment variable.
